problem.complexity: O(n * k log k) time where k is max length of word, O(n*k) space.
problem.explanation: Iterate through words, sorting each to use as a hash map key. Group anagrams under the same key.
hints: Use sorted strings as dictionary keys.
problem.statement_markdown: Write `group_anagrams(words)` to group words that are anagrams. Return a list of groups, where each group is sorted alphabetically, and the list of groups is sorted by the first element.
problem.title: Group anagrams together
